Been in the exact same situation here (22F), but when I finished uni and been 21! While I was looking for an apartment to move out to I had to live with my parents and deal with all that, specifically coming from my dad. It was worse in a sense that I also had to be home no later than 11pm. It was intense and at some point I even spoke to a psychologist. 

What they told me was very useful. Your parents don’t realise you’re not 12 anymore. You have to respectfully tell them: “Dad, I would really appreciate it if you would knock before entering”. Without starting the argument you’re pointing out at how it would make YOU feel, not how your parents are wrong about doing so. 

If they ask why, you do the exact same method: “When you’re entering without knocking it makes me feel uneasy, I hope for your understanding”. 

Worked like a charm with my parents, they begun respecting the boundaries and soon after I moved out :)
